title: Tier Tracker
description: Tiertagger, but for all the tierlists! Supports: MCTiers, Subtiers, PvPTiers, and FlowPvP.
body:
# Tier Tracker

Tier Tracker is a mod that tracks rankings across most major tierlists. Tier Tracker can swap between tierlists as well as gamemodes using a hotkey, or its integration with Mod Menu. 

![TierTracker Changing Lists](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1184b5ef50b58b3ead8bc5e6ddc14fc578a1dbf7.gif)

# Currently Supported Tierlists:

- FlowPvP
- MCTiers
- PvPTiers
- Subtiers

# Planned Tierlists:

- MCPvP (when released)
- ArtualCM Ladder

# Features:

- Auto-Detect Server and swap between tierlists
- Support for 4 major tier lists
- Hotkeys for swapping between tierlists and gamemodes
- /tt command that lists a player's tiers across all tier lists
- Tier colors in the nametag for FlowPvP, like MCTiers (a better tier is brighter!)
